text: J-Space Cognition Suite 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的复杂任务智能体预设：通过 bundle 注册预设，并组合提示、文件与搜索、任务、计划、技能、后台作业和网页工具。它提供持久任务控制器、仓库阅读与记录流程、基于证据的检查及工作区账本，适合长周期的软件工程和资料分析任务。安装后在新会话中选择该预设；不需要额外模型密钥配置，模型与权限沿用 DSH。

J-Space Cognition Suite is a DSH preset for complex, long-running tasks. It combines filesystem, planning, skills, scheduling, and web tools with persistent task notes, repository analysis, and evidence-based checks. Choose it when creating a session; it uses DSH model settings.
想让 DSH 在长时间的代码任务里持续记录目标、进度和下一步。
有没有适合复杂仓库分析、能先建立文件地图再追踪代码证据的智能体预设？
我希望把大型工程任务拆成阶段，并在关键步骤保存可恢复的状态。
DSH 能否按任务需要加载不同的推理和验证指导？
想在完成开发工作前检查改动是否满足目标，并保留检查依据。
I need a DSH workflow that keeps durable notes and progress for a long coding task.
Help me map a large repository and tie architecture notes back to source files.
Can my DSH session track checkpoints and verify task evidence before I call the work done?
J-Space Cognition Suite 的功能「DSH 智能体预设」：把工作流注册为可选预设，并组合文件、任务、计划、技能和网页等 DSH 能力。安装插件后，在创建会话时选择该预设。
J-Space Cognition Suite 的功能「持久任务控制器」：为长任务记录目标、工作状态和证据，并提供读取与检查流程。用户按任务阶段调用控制器命令，结果保存在任务目录的记录中。
J-Space Cognition Suite 的功能「仓库地图与源码追踪」：指导智能体建立指向源文件的仓库地图，再检查地图所依据的代码。适合跨文件理解工程结构与影响范围。
J-Space Cognition Suite 的功能「实证验证流程」：在推导停滞时要求明确未知项、设计可证伪的检查，并将测量结果写回结论。智能体按技能说明执行该流程。
J-Space Cognition Suite 使用前须知：预设提供控制器与工作流指导，但需要智能体按协议调用；安装预设本身不会自动装载宿主事件钩子。

**简体中文** | [English](<README.en.md>)

在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 [J-Space Cognition Suite](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/J-Space-Cognition-Suite)。安装后，新建会话时选择 **J-Space Cognition Suite** 预设即可。

J-Space 提供一套拆解问题、分析仓库、记录任务进度和检查结果的方法。这个项目把它接入 DSH，保留原版的认知模块、控制器和工作区账本。模型、工具和权限沿用 DSH 的配置；需要多智能体协作时，使用 DSH 官方的「智能体团队」。

J-Space 本身由上游项目维护，这个仓库负责 DSH 适配。

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · 安装：1.2.5 的验证环境是 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 / Cordis 4.0.5**，另外在 `0.2.1-rc.3` 和 `0.2.2-alpha.2`（Cordis `4.0.6-alpha.1`）上验证过安装和预设加载。下面固定使用 rc.4 这个版本，不依赖 npm 标签的指向；`next` 标签现在也指向它，而 `latest` 仍是较早的 `0.2.1-rc.2`。更旧的 `0.2.0-rc.2` 缺少本预设需要的定时工具，不能完整加载，请先升级。

```bash

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · 已使用对应 DSH 版本时，可以跳过这一条：npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.4

dsh plugin --profile web add @anonyjcy/dsh-j-space@1.2.5
```

已有 DSH 部署时，请在启动该部署的安装环境中升级，并先备份自定义配置。使用自定义 profile 的话，把 `web` 换成实际名称。

安装后重启 DSH Web，新建会话，在 **Agent Preset** 中选择 **J-Space Cognition Suite**。只在普通项目里安装 npm 包，不会把预设注册到 DSH；也不用再运行旧版 `install` 命令。bash
git clone https://github.com/AnonyJcy/dsh-j-space.git
cd dsh-j-space
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.1-rc.4

创建成员、发消息、分配任务和管理成员生命周期，都交给官方插件。J-Space 预设不再单独注册 `subagent`、`fork` 和成员控制工具，也不会自动启用团队；只有用户明确要求时才创建团队。不装团队插件，也可以单智能体使用。

原版 [orchestration 模块](<preset/skills/j-space/modules/orchestration.md>) 仍然保留。它记录参与者的工作和验收依据，不是另一套团队管理器：成员各自读取源文件、二次考量和独立验收的要求没有删除。控制器里的 `agent add` / `retire` 也只是记账，不会创建或停止 DSH 成员。

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · dsh-j-space：J-Space provides workflows for breaking down problems, exploring repositories, keeping task notes, and checking results. This package brings those workflows to DSH without replacing the original modules, controller, or workspace ledger. Models, tools, and permissions come from DSH; collaboration uses its official Agent Teams plugin.

The upstream project maintains J-Space itself. This repository maintains the DSH integration.

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Install：Version 1.2.5 was tested with **DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 / Cordis 4.0.5**, and also installed and loaded on `0.2.1-rc.3` and `0.2.2-alpha.2` (Cordis `4.0.6-alpha.1`). The commands below pin rc.4 rather than relying on npm tags: the `next` tag now points at it, while `latest` is still the older `0.2.1-rc.2`. The much older `0.2.0-rc.2` is missing a required scheduling tool and cannot fully load this preset, so upgrade first if you use it.

```bash

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Skip this if you already run the matching DSH version：npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.4

dsh plugin --profile web add @anonyjcy/dsh-j-space@1.2.5
```

For an existing deployment, upgrade the installation that actually starts your DSH process and back up custom settings first. Replace `web` with your profile name if needed.

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Using Agent Teams：To use teams, install the official plugin in the same profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.1-rc.4
```

The official plugin handles members, messages, task assignments, and member lifecycle. The J-Space preset no longer registers its own `subagent`, `fork`, or member-control tools. It does not enable teams automatically: creating a team requires an explicit user request. You can also use J-Space with a single agent.

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Using Agent Teams：The original [orchestration module](<preset/skills/j-space/modules/orchestration.md>) stays in place. It records work and review evidence, rather than managing a second team. Participants still need their own source reads, second consideration, and independent acceptance. The controller's `agent add` / `retire` commands record evidence roles; they do not create or stop DSH members.

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Using Agent Teams：`workflow` remains available for explicitly requested batch orchestration. Its children are not official Team members. See the [DSH integration notes](<preset/skills/j-space/integration/dsh.md>) for the details.

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Updating from older releases：The [legacy CLI](<bin/cli.js>) is still included, but it only manages a file copy under `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/j-space`. Its `status` / `verify` commands cannot tell whether the current DSH preset is registered; check the new-session menu instead. The standalone Cordis deployment plugin also copies legacy files rather than registering a modern preset.

Release history is in the [changelog](<CHANGELOG.md>).

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Original J-Space files：This package uses upstream SV1 at commit [b2023124](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/J-Space-Cognition-Suite/tree/b2023124a1fa08278e3ee82aefa8ed9faeade995). All 13 modules, seven references, original examples, controller, and full reread routines are retained.

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Original J-Space files：Of the 26 original skill files, 25 are byte-for-byte unchanged. The [skill entry](<preset/skills/j-space/SKILL.md>) adds a removable DSH note, with separate [integration notes](<preset/skills/j-space/integration/dsh.md>). A [compressed archive](<vendor/j-space/canonical.tar.gz>) and [hash manifest](<vendor/j-space/manifest.json>) preserve the originals for verification and restoration.

@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space README · Original J-Space files：The archive compresses files, not model input. It does not replace original text with summaries or reduce the tokens needed to read it. Original repeated prompts and scheduled full rereads are unchanged.

Run these commands from the installed package root to verify the files or restore the archive:

```bash
python3 -B tools/upstream_integrity.py verify --runtime preset/skills/j-space --adapters vendor/j-space/adapters.json
